biotools.summary: nf-gwas is a Nextflow pipeline for performing highly parallelized and reproducible genome-wide association studies (GWAS) on biobank-scale data. It automates preprocessing and analysis steps, integrates regression modeling, and provides comprehensive reporting with interactive visualizations.
